title: Green Cell UPS
description: UPS state from the gcups Prometheus exporter (https://github.com/n1eko/gcups).

panels.title: Power source
panels.description: Whether the UPS is running on mains or on battery (gcups_utility_fail).

panels.title: Connection
panels.description: Exporter → app API → UPS. API down: the app is not responding (see README troubleshooting). UPS disconnected: the app runs but sees no UPS.

panels.title: Battery charge
panels.description: Battery charge level (gcups_battery_level_ratio).

panels.title: Load
panels.description: Output load as a share of the UPS capacity (gcups_load_ratio).

panels.title: Estimated output
panels.description: Load × rated power (gcups_load_ratio × gcups_rated_power_va). An estimate in VA, not a measurement.

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: UPS temperature (gcups_temperature_celsius). Many models have no sensor.

panels.title: Input voltage
panels.description: Mains input voltage (gcups_input_voltage_volts).

panels.title: Output voltage
panels.description: Voltage delivered to the connected equipment (gcups_output_voltage_volts).

panels.title: Input frequency
panels.description: Mains frequency (gcups_input_frequency_hertz).

panels.title: Battery voltage
panels.description: Battery voltage (gcups_battery_voltage_volts).

panels.title: Alarms
panels.description: Count of active alarms: on battery, battery low, UPS fault, shutdown pending.

panels.title: Last scrape
panels.description: Time the exporter spent reading the app API (gcups_scrape_duration_seconds).

panels.title: Voltage
panels.description: Input, output and input-fault voltage. Dashed gray: nominal input voltage.

panels.title: Load
panels.description: Output load. Dashed lines mark 70% (warning) and 90% (critical).

panels.title: Input frequency
panels.description: Mains frequency. Dashed gray: nominal frequency.

panels.title: Estimated output power
panels.description: Load × rated power, in VA. An estimate, not a measurement.

panels.title: Battery charge
panels.description: Battery charge level. Dashed lines mark 30% (critical) and 60% (warning).

panels.title: Battery voltage
panels.description: Battery voltage. Dashed gray: the UPS's nominal battery voltage range (low / nominal / high).

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: UPS temperature. Empty when the model has no temperature sensor.

panels.title: Status flags
panels.description: Every status flag reported by the UPS over time. 'Offline flag' is shown as reported by the UPS status register; use 'On battery' to detect power loss.

panels.title: Device information
panels.description: Identification reported by the UPS (gcups_ups_info).

panels.title: Ratings
panels.description: Nominal ratings reported by the UPS (gcups_nominal_* and gcups_rated_power_va).

panels.title: Exporter scrape duration
panels.description: Time the exporter spent reading the app API per scrape.
